brief: An FPV drone pit station for a drone pilot, built in place of the starter base; the viewer is on the side of larger r. Back row at r -1, q 0 to 5, every cell two storeys tall: half-n bases at q 0 and q 5 make two drawer towers, with a drawer on each storey facing the viewer (drawers need half bases on both storeys); full bases at q 1 to 4 carry bins on the top storey, a plain bin at q 1 and divided bins at q 2 to 4, filled with M3 screws, nuts and standoffs. In front, a one-storey deck of covered full bases at q 0, r 1 and at q 1 to 4 on r 0 and r 1 is the work surface. Along the front of the deck, each on its own cover: the radio at q 0, the hex driver set (hexdriver-set) at q 1, the 5-inch quad (quad-5in) at q 2, turned about 30 degrees so its arms stay on its own cover, the multimeter at q 3 and the goggles at q 4, all on r 1. Cap the open faces and lock the joints.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
